name: Any-position AP diagnosis
exact rule: ICD-9-CM 577.0 OR normalized ICD-10-CM code beginning K85 in any diagnosis position
required fields: encounter ID; diagnosis code; code version
missing rule: No diagnosis record is distinguishable from a recorded non-AP code only at the database-capability layer; P0 returns not identifiable if the entire diagnosis domain is absent
reference overlap: No clinical-domain rule shared; diagnosis information may remain visible in source text

name: Principal-position AP diagnosis
exact rule: P0 code in the locally verified principal-diagnosis position (MIMIC seq_num=1)
required fields: P0 fields; diagnosis position with verified semantics
missing rule: Partial/not computable when principal-position semantics are unavailable or unverified
reference overlap: No clinical-domain rule shared; diagnosis information may remain visible in source text

name: Any-position code plus enzyme
exact rule: P0 AND at least one lipase/amylase result from -24 to +48 h relative to admission with valuenum/ref_range_upper >=3.0
required fields: P0 fields; item ID; chart time; numeric value; unit; row-specific upper reference limit
missing rule: No enzyme or no valid contemporaneous ULN is not computable for the enzyme requirement; never substitute a global threshold in direct transport
reference overlap: Shares enzyme items, ULN calculation, threshold, and window with the reference construction (partial circularity)

name: Atlanta-like two-of-three rule
exact rule: At least two positive domains among pain, enzyme >=3x row-specific ULN, and imaging; pain positive requires no pain-negation flag; frozen imaging implementation counts a positive flag even if a negative flag also occurs
time window: Full-hospitalization Scenario A; clinical events anchored to admission, enzyme -24 to +48 h
required fields: pain assertion; enzyme assertion; imaging assertion; polarity; time; provenance; availability
missing rule: Unavailable domain remains unavailable and is not converted to negative; output records domain coverage and not-computable reasons
reference overlap: Shares all three domains, lexicons, threshold, window, and decision structure (constructive circularity)

name: Transparent evidence score
missing rule: Same domain availability rules as P3
revised role: Canonicalization proved P4 logically equivalent to P3; retained only in specification and excluded as an independent comparator

name: L2-regularized logistic implementation
exact rule: Seven frozen features: any AP code, principal AP code, enzyme >=3xULN, normalized log maximum ULN multiple, pain flag, imaging flag, and pancreatitis-history flag; C=1.0, balanced classes, threshold 0.50
missing rule: Feature absence follows frozen binary extraction; no imputed clinical domain
reference overlap: Shares enzyme, pain, and imaging inputs; fitted on 218 adjudicable development encounters with 39 positives
revised role: Excluded from main empirical comparison because event-per-feature support and inferential uncertainty were inadequate; specification retained for transparency
